item.title: Consistent litter and flies, 29th July
item.description:
At the beginning of Montpelier Road, on the left hand side when coming from Queen's Road, there has been persistent household litter scattered everywhere for years. Yesterday there was a bloody meat packet absolutely swarming in flies in the middle of the street. I think it has to be coming from either the flats on the corner, or one of the first few houses, but it's really horrible stepping out into such gross litter every day. Could you put through letterboxes a reminder about fines, maybe? Someone could come and clean but whoever it is will just keep doing it, so maybe a sign or a leaflet would help? Many thanks
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 33, Montpelier Road, Peckham, Greater London
